XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: "P-R-N-D-S" warning lights flash, gearbox suddenly shifts into neutral
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | DSG | DQ200 | GEAR | ENGAGEMENT | SYMBOL | FLASHING | | P0716 | P0722 | P0746 | P0751 | P0756 | P0761 | P0766 | P0776 | P1707 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with a 6-speed DSG automatic gearbox (DQ250)

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Electronic gearbox control unit

  • Fault: Whilst driving, the vehicle suddenly shifts into neutral. The ‘P-R-N-D-S’ indicator lights on the gear lever flash. When the engine is cold, the system temporarily resumes normal operation. The condition tends to worsen until it becomes a permanent fault.

  • Fault codes detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0716 (17100) – Gearbox input speed sensor (G182) – implausible signal
    • P0722 (17106) – Gearbox output speed sensor (G195) – no signal
    • P0746 (17130) – Pressure control solenoid valve 1 (N215) short-circuited to earth
    • P0751 (17135) – Gearbox solenoid valve 1 (N88) short-circuited to earth
    • P0756 (17140) – Gearbox solenoid valve 2 (N89) short circuit to earth
    • P0761 (17145) – Gearbox solenoid valve 3 (N90) short circuit to earth
    • P0766 (17150) – Gearbox solenoid valve 4 (N91) short circuit to earth
    • P0776 (17160) – Pressure control solenoid valve 2 (N216) short circuit to earth
    • P1707 (18115) – Fault in the mechatronic control unit
  • Cause: Malfunction of the DSG gearbox mechatronic control unit

• Action: Check and, if necessary, replace the mechatronic control unit of the gearbox

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Faults in the electronic gearbox control unit are quite common in the DSG DQ250
